# Vinayak Bhardwaj

> Mechanical engineer based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Worked on Malaysian job sites since September 2018: QA/QC on commercial builds, site engineering and structural QA/QC on the 70-acre Tun Razak Exchange (TRX) with WCT, and rope-access façade operations on Menara Maybank and KLCC-district towers with Rotol Group. Now builds AI agent workflows and websites through Virin Digital, and produces long-form documentaries on Vinayak Tech.

## Services (Kuala Lumpur)

- AI agent workflows: manual processes such as lead intake, reporting or document checks, rebuilt as agent pipelines with a checking step and a cost cap.
- Websites: hand-built sites for founders and service businesses, fast on phones and readable by search engines and AI assistants.
- Documentary and explainer video: research from primary documents, motion graphics in Remotion, audio mastered to -14 LUFS.

- TRX (WCT, 2021–2024): every Non-Conformance Report in his zones closed at root cause.
